rules.condition: is this bot's hp below a quarter of its max?
rules.criteria_true: hp is less than 25% of max hp
rules.criteria_false: hp is 25% or more of max hp

rules.condition: is there exactly one isolated enemy visible?
rules.criteria_true: one enemy exists that is farthest from any other enemy
rules.criteria_false: no single isolated enemy exists or multiple are grouped

rules.condition: is the selected target within staccato range and is staccato off cooldown?
rules.criteria_true: target is in range and ability is ready
rules.criteria_false: target is out of range or ability is on cooldown

rules.condition: is a target about to escape and is solo off cooldown?
rules.criteria_true: a target is retreating and ability is ready
rules.criteria_false: no target is escaping or ability is on cooldown

rules.condition: is there no immediate fight opportunity?
rules.criteria_true: no isolated enemy is currently available to engage
